data.name: Aafiyaun
data.gender_notes: Aafiyaun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'aafiyah' meaning 'sound, healthy, or free from disease'. This name symbolizes the giver of life, providing comfort and vitality. The name Aafiyaun carries the meaning “Giver of Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aafiyaun usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafiyaun is a name that symbolizes the attainment of spiritual and emotional healing. It is a name that inspires hope and optimism, and encourages the bearer to seek inner peace and harmony.
data.etymology: Aafiyaun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafiyaun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أَفِيَونَ
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَفِيَونَ: اسم علم من الأسماء العربية، يُتَفَرَّد به المولود الصالح، يعني «أَن يُتَوَفَّى المال وَالأَموال» من خلال عمل الخير والصالحات، والاستغفار، والصوم، والصدقة، والسعي في سيرته المباركة، وحفظ القرآن الكريم، والتسبيح لله تعالى. يُعد هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تُشير إلى الإحسان والطيب، وأنه يُمنع أن يُتَوَفَّى المال وَالأَموال من خلال الفساد والذنوب. ويُحتسب هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تُشير إلى الإخلاص والصادق الناطق بالحق. وقد كان هذا الاسم مشهورًا في العصور الإسلامية الأولى، حيث كان يتمتع به المولودون الذين كانوا مشهورين بصدقهم وتقواهم. ويُعد هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تُشير إلى الإخلاص والصادق الناطق بالحق، والعمل الصالح الذي يُكسب المال وَالأَموال. ويُحتسب هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تُشير إلى الإخلاص والصادق الناطق بالحق، والعمل الصالح الذي يُكسب المال وَالأَموال

in_english.name: Aafiyaun
in_english.meaning: To be free from worldly wealth and possessions
in_english.long_meaning: Aafiyaun: A name derived from Arabic roots, meaning to be free from worldly wealth and possessions, and to be a righteous and truthful person. It is associated with the virtues of sincerity, honesty, and charitable deeds. In Islamic tradition, such a person is considered as one who has escaped the worldly attachments and has attained spiritual enlightenment. The name Aafiyaun is also linked with the concept of 'tawbah' or repentance, which is an essential aspect of Islamic faith. In modern times, the name Aafiyaun is still used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the values of righteousness, honesty, and selflessness.
